ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0027 owns this section: it records that the corpus promises an open decision process for AI integration without defining the process, the authority, or the current outcome. The item is a query with no wording ruling, so the baseline stands and the promise is restored unchanged, in both its Chapter Six form and this one. The item's paydown criteria contemplate removing redundant promises; that is an author decision the item has not yet made, and this pass does not act on it. refrainAnchor.refrain: The same discipline that has governed the previous chapters applies here, followed by a run of Providence is not / It is not denials and a bounded statement of the current early stage.
refrainAnchor.relatedForms: At its current early stage occurs four times; the cleft What Providence is being designed to do, at its current early stage, is operate at the layer occurs twice, in Providence and the Currency Question and Providence and the Builder Field, and both instances survive intact in the current manuscript.
refrainAnchor.analysis: The refrain is the volume's honesty mechanism: each constructive chapter ends by refusing the claim the chapter might have seemed to make. The recurrence is deliberate and protected by the voice card, which names bounded statements of what Providence is and is not as an intentional recurrent form, so catalog 4.9's retention limb applies to every instance and none should be thinned. The denial runs are real refusals of positions readers actually infer, so catalog 4.3 and R-NEGATION-STACK do not fire; the corrected position follows each run in the same paragraph. The ledger cost is engaged once per instance: each recurrence restates the CTD-0055 requirement posture, and the two cleft instances plus the two designed-toward passages carry the CTD-0027 open-development promise. A single ruling on the refrain's wording would move all five sections at once; no such ruling exists, and no edit is needed.
refrainAnchor.singleEditThatWouldSettleIt: None required. If the author ever rules on CTD-0027's redundant-promise criterion, the edit would fall on the twin closing passages of this section and Providence and Artificial Intelligence, not on the refrain opening.

findings.diagnosis: Checked against the rebuild alternative. The interpolation is a purpose list whose items carry no internal commas, the to help opener and or support closer bracket it audibly, and the Whether subject holds the spine until is resumes it. The Chapter Six twin renders the same content as a participial list after a comma, so the comma treatment is also the consistent one. Kept, with the cost named: the resumption at is a research question asks slightly more of the reader than the dashes did.
